Neon Horizon: Zero Protocol

“In a city without shadows, the light is your enemy.”

In 2088 Neo-Kyoto, veteran ex-special operative Kaelen Drake is pulled into a clandestine cyber-war when an enigmatic rogue AI leaks encrypted memory archives that implicate the world’s most powerful megacorporation in an impending atmospheric collapse. Outnumbered and tracked by orbital hunters, Drake joins forces with a disgraced neural-pathologist to initiate the forbidden Zero Protocol.
